label: D1 after reward (two in a row), early episode, agent about to choose a2
explanation: Fires only at D1 and only when the reward input is 1 (100% of mass). It is confined to the first ~45 trials of the episode (rate ~7-8% in trials 0-39, ~0 after trial 50), so it acts like an episode-time or slow-drift signal. Within that window it prefers steps where the agent is about to choose a2 (92% of mass; a2 is its own upcoming choice, which is legitimate, not a future outcome) and where the trial before the previous one was also rewarded. Value sits in a narrow band (7.54-7.73), and the D1 policy logit leans mildly toward a2. Never fires at GO or D2, after an unrewarded trial, or late in the episode. Activations are tiny and graded, and they often grow across consecutive rewarded a2 trials. The largest ones come right after a switch from a1 to a2 following a rare reward. Dev F1 is 0.79 (precision 0.71, recall 0.90). Dropping the a2 and two-rewards conditions gives recall 0.99 but precision 0.31.
